subject: derived_tests
summary: Derived Vitest for Reservation::lookup covers every live W2 failure post at standard density: HoldMissingOrNotVisibleErrorOnLookup (named PreconditionError, not UnauthorizedError/builtins), HoldsUnchangedOnHoldMissingLookup (including empty-holds baseline and stock unchanged), UnauthorizedErrorOnLookup (named UnauthorizedError), HoldsUnchangedOnUnauthorizedLookup, and AvailableStockUnchangedOnUnauthorizedLookup; PrincipalAuthorized / HoldExists violation paths are exercised. W1 success posts remain. Suite is not empty or “does not throw” only. solidsdd-lint pass with zero findings. Distinct not-visible (e.g. expired) case remains polish because OCL/Brief share one PreconditionError channel with missing.

findings.detail: Failure coverage uses a missing holdId only. Scenario/Brief also name not-visible; OCL defers whether expired holds are not-visible vs a distinct failure and shares the same PreconditionError channel, so a separate expired/not-visible case is not required for W2 checkability. An optional case that treats an expired-but-still-present hold as the shared missing/not-visible error would strengthen R2 symmetry.

Missing-hold no-mutation cases assert stock unchanged for the seeded SKU even though live OCL only posts HoldsUnchangedOnHoldMissingLookup when the hold is absent (stock implied). Extra checkability is fine; optional multi-SKU isolation on the failure path (as on the W1 success isolation case) remains polish only.
